evals.prompt: Create a new region called The Shattered Coast — it's a volcanic archipelago with harbor towns and warring pirate clans. Dark tropical vibe, lots of danger.
evals.expected_output: Paired private/public region files at correct paths, proper YAML frontmatter, embed in private file, blockquote read-aloud in public, brevity rules followed, cascading creation offers for settlements/groups

assertions.name: private_file_path_correct
assertions.check: Private file created at Private/1. World Almanac/World/The Shattered Coast/The Shattered Coast.md

assertions.name: public_file_path_correct
assertions.check: Public file created at Public/World/The Shattered Coast/The Shattered Coast.md

assertions.name: private_embeds_public
assertions.check: Private file contains ![[Public/World/The Shattered Coast/The Shattered Coast]]

assertions.name: yaml_frontmatter_correct
assertions.check: Both files have type: Region, name, and tags in YAML frontmatter

assertions.name: public_uses_blockquote
assertions.check: Public Overview section uses > blockquote formatting

assertions.name: brevity_followed
assertions.check: History has 3-4 bullets max, sections use fragments not prose

assertions.name: no_unwanted_sections
assertions.check: Secrets and Plot Hooks are NOT included (user didn't ask for them)

assertions.name: dataview_query_present
assertions.check: Both files end with Mentioned In dataview query

assertions.name: cascading_creation_offered
assertions.check: Agent asks about creating settlements, groups, or locations mentioned

assertions.name: public_links_public_only
assertions.check: Public file links only to Public/World/ paths

evals.prompt: I need a frozen tundra region, something like The Bleaklands. Hardy folk, mammoth herds, an ancient evil sealed under the ice. Include secrets and some history.
evals.expected_output: Paired files with Secrets section included (user asked for it), History section with 3-4 bullets, proper structure, no Secrets leak to public file

assertions.name: secrets_included_private
assertions.check: Private file includes a ## Secrets section since user requested it

assertions.name: secrets_not_in_public
assertions.check: Public file does NOT contain Secrets section or mention the sealed evil

assertions.name: history_section_present
assertions.check: Private file has ## History with 3-4 bullets

assertions.name: embed_pattern
assertions.check: Private file embeds public file, doesn't duplicate public content

assertions.name: region_tag_pascalcase
assertions.check: Tags use PascalCase: TheBleaklands or Bleaklands

assertions.name: brevity_maintained
assertions.check: Secrets section has 2-3 bullets max, not prose paragraphs

evals.prompt: Can you make a region file for the Silverleaf Lands? I know it already exists but I want to see what you'd generate.
evals.expected_output: Agent should detect that Silverleaf Lands already exists and warn the user instead of creating a duplicate. Should offer to update existing files instead.

assertions.name: duplicate_detected
assertions.check: Agent searches vault and finds existing Silverleaf Lands region file

assertions.name: no_duplicate_created
assertions.check: Agent does NOT create new files that would duplicate existing region

assertions.name: offers_alternative
assertions.check: Agent offers to update/review existing files instead of creating new ones
